text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly realize that Mihono Bourbon
is in the
gym, training away in silence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure she's been at it for almost
two
hours now—with no rest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. I was lost
deep in
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I have a question that requires your
input. Do
you find me frightening?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There have been rumors among the
academy
students that I may be a
cyborg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm initially surprised by the absurdity of
this
rumor, but intrigue makes me want
to find out
more.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The rumor took on a life of its own
before I could
confirm or deny the
claims...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear?! Mihono Bourbon can
shoot beams
out of her eyes!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! I heard she can also fire
rockets
from her mouth!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rumors spawned more rumors, and soon
enough
my image had ballooned into
something else
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One time, I merely picked up and
handed
someone her towel, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Please, have mercy! Not the beams!
Anything but
the beams!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How others evaluate me is none of my
concern.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I've determined that my
frightening
image is a cause for concern,
unintentional
though it may be.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As such, I've been searching for a
solution to this
predicament.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you have any suggestions, I would
appreciate
your input.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see your point. So I should first work on
being
more expressive.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I've received many
comments about
my lack of expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your valuable insight. I will

commence training my facial muscles at
once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She proceeds to buckle down into
training her
facial muscles...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she has such a lovely smile! Is she
really a
cyborg?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's not scary at all! Yeah, she's
definitely just a
regular Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the misunderstanding has
been
cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inflection... That is, to raise and lower
the tone of
my voice. I see your point.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So the misunderstanding stemmed from
my
mechanical-sounding voice. It is a
plausible
theory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Situation confirmed. Inputting tone
inflection. I
appreciate your valuable
insight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Mihono Bourbon starts to
speak
with inflection—in her own unique
way. However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: HeeeLLLoOo EvERyyyOoOooNe!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Is she yodeling or something?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know... Maybe she's trying out
her new
update?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ends up instilling even more fear
amongst the
students.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Commencing new search for solutions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gets tunnel vision searching for a
new
solution and is unable to
concentrate on training.
